sources.title: Ceramic Shield PPF - Gloss Clear
sources.excerpt: Ceramic Shield Gloss Clear is Geoshield's flagship protective film, engineered with a 6.5-mil TPU core and ceramic-infused layers.

sources.title: How to Protect Your Car's Finish
sources.excerpt: Ceramic coatings with silicon dioxide produce high gloss and water beading and cling tenaciously to the clear coat.

sources.title: SecureTrack for car owners
sources.excerpt: The vendor describes real-time GPS tracking through its SecureTrack app and 24/7 monitoring with action after theft or sabotage.

sources.title: Vehicle Theft Prevention
sources.excerpt: Vehicle recovery systems use electronic transmission technology to help law enforcement reveal the location of stolen vehicles.
